scope: Shared BnModel topology/source ownership and budgeted backend preparation, with a separately reproduced AVX512 softmax scratch-alignment fix found during full host sanitizer validation

fixture_leak_cleanup.fix: Free test-owned runtime policy snapshots at teardown and before memset, detach and free the mock model backend/container. No production policy or numerical behavior changes.
fixture_leak_cleanup.verification: Full Clang ASAN/UBSAN transformer suite with leak detection enabled plus final standard suite.

sanitizer_toolchain.reason: GCC13 ASAN O1 fake-stack alignment faults reproduced in both AVX512 scratch and ordinary aggregate initialization. Full suite is independently instrumented with Clang18, retaining AVX512 and leak/UB checks.

avx512_tail_regression.observed_fault: GCC 13 ASAN -O1 native/256-preferred build issued aligned 64-byte vmovaps from a 32-byte-aligned fake-stack tail buffer. Independent softmax-only reproducer failed before the change and passed after.
avx512_tail_regression.fix: C11 _Alignas(64) for internal AVX512 tail scratch. External inputs remain unaligned; arithmetic unchanged.
avx512_tail_regression.test: Lengths 1..79 cover all vector tails and 64-element normalization boundaries against scalar, with external buffer guards.

ownership.BnModel: Owns immutable architecture-planned anatomy and per-layer quantized expert source descriptors. Minimal shared config is mapped by model_arch. GGUF directory/payload mappings remain borrowed and must outlive model/requests; source I/O descriptor arrays are owned by existing BnModelIO. No legacy CPU layer weights are fabricated.
ownership.BnBackendModel: Owns device weights/packed resources. New model preparation wrapper consumes shared anatomy/maps/file through the existing transactional GLM binder with explicit device and host staging budgets. Expert sources/cache and per-request memory are excluded from these backend preparation budgets.
ownership.BnSession: Backend-only sessions allocate host logits/history. Legacy CPU session creation and legacy GPU weight upload reject topology-only models. The qualified private request executor still owns its mutable state in backend session resources.

corrected_initial_validation_failure.reason: Direct MoE config writes in model.c violated architecture ownership.
corrected_initial_validation_failure.resolution: Moved shared admission/source metadata mapping into model_arch helper. Boundary checks unchanged; revised full suite passes.

limits: The ordinary loader guard remains; CLI and shared BF16 position/capacity/restart/forward dispatch have not yet admitted GLM.
Qualified fused-recurrent KDA and deterministic chronological sparse selection profiles remain explicit; default HF/vLLM generation parity not established.
No natural-prompt coherence or performance parity claim.

Actual CUDA host ASAN/UBSAN instruments the changed owner/lifecycle sources and existing request/layout paths; device kernels were not reinstrumented in this ownership stage. Previous long-stage filtered device checks are separate evidence.
